children: On September 24, 2026, the Board of Trustees of
BNY Mellon High Yield Strategies Fund (NYSE: DHF)

declared from net investment income a monthly cash dividend of $0.0175 per share of beneficial interest, payable on October 23, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on October 8, 2026. The ex-dividend date is October 8, 2026. The previous dividend declared in August was $0.0175 per share of beneficial interest.

BNY Mellon Investment Adviser, Inc., the investment adviser for the Fund, is part of BNY Investments. BNY Investments is one of the world’s largest asset managers, with $2.2 trillion in assets under management as of June 30, 2026. Through a client-first approach, BNY Investments brings investors specialist expertise through its seven investment firms offering solutions across every major asset class and backed by the breadth and scale of BNY.
